dict.string: Hardy uses the microphone for on-device “Hey Ada” when the ear is on, and for one command clip or push-to-talk after that. Nothing is sent to the engine until you speak a request or hold the mic.
Hardy listens to system audio so it can hear “hey Ada” and board requests from what is already playing on the desk.
Hardy needs Screen Recording to see the display it docks to and to capture board context from the screen.
